title: How are we doing clothing?
author: roorood
selftext:
I wonder if anyone has a workable solution to equippable clothing items for MMO style games?

I’m currently just seeing how far I can push AI in an attempt to build an MMO. 

I currently use Claude and GPT both on the 5x plans. 

And the real struggle I’m having is clothing… getting either model to create the item to a quality that would be production ready just feels impossible.

I’m using UE5.8 - meta human bodies with mutable and body mesh hiding for non exposed flesh. But still, the quality of any garment is just so dull and lifeless I just don’t know how many times I can tell the agent to give it texture… 

Is there a solution for this? Any tips or tricks??

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: marvelous designer saw someone use an mcp and knock it out the park, so gpt does the design image ,

comments.author: _HoundOfJustice
comments.body: Mavelous Designer is the boss of clothing and garments. Its industry standard for that kind of work and i never regretted integrating it into my pipeline.

replies.author: roorood
replies.body:
The previous comment mentioned it has an MCP - what does your workflow look like? 

Do you have an agent design the garment and create it completely in MD?

replies.author: _HoundOfJustice
replies.body: I actually prefer to do it myself as i generally do like to be the artist through the entire pipeline. Yes, Astra can do quite a lot too, but i have strict rules for it so if it does something like that it takes a lot time and tokens. I dont like how people use MCP and generally Astra or Opus when it comes to such things because they rush it or dont want to take time for those tasks and it shows.

comments.author: denhopeEUW
comments.body:
for an MMO fantasy style game its pretty hard

for my sci fi game I was able to use the Epic Games Clothing assets in FAB and Claude mapped them to my metahumans. After this you can reskin the hoodies, shirts, pants, joggers etc. 

but afaik epic has no free assets for fantasy characters.

There are a lot of tutorials on youtube for marvelous designer, tripo3D etc. but I wasnt successful with it

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Pretty sure that’s for fixing messy topology, and nothing about clothing at all.
